metadata.title: From Fold to Physics: An Exact, Parameter-Free and Machine-Closed Reconstruction of Physical Science from Smithian Fold Theory
metadata.description:

It does not rewrite a derivation or receipt. Maria Smith's authorship and the Ernos Labs open-science mission remain integrated with the technical evidence.
